description: REVIEW TEMPLATE ONLY. Game-neutral practice match scouting; replace after agreeing team requirements. This is not the 2027 season schema. One team in one match per entry.

fields.description: Explicit match label, for example Q42. Never infer from receive time.
fields.question: Which match was this (for example Q42)?

fields.description: Positive FRC team number. Do not confuse match number with team number.
fields.question: Which team number were you scouting?

fields.description: Whether the robot completed a climb. False only for an explicit failure or no climb; missing mention is unknown.
fields.question: Did the robot complete a climb?

fields.description: Other observations in the scout's own words, including cycle speed, defence and breakdowns.
fields.question: Any other observations?
